newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips softer, technology stocks mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips softer, technology stocks mixed.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average had a soft tone in mixed and volatile trading on Wednesday, but strength in particular issues like International Business Machines Corp lent support.

U.S. blue chips were off around 21 points or 0.28 percent to 7362. But IBM, which started trading on a post-split basis, was up 2-1/8 to 91-1/2. "IBM is having a beautiful day," Frank Calta, an equity trader at Dain Bosworth said.
The Nasdaq composite, heavily-weighted with technology stocks, was up nearly one point to 1410. Technology stocks were mixed.
On Tuesday, a surge in technology stocks like those semiconductor-markers and networking firms, drove broader stock indices to fresh highs despite rising bond yields.

But while some networking shares, like Bay Networks Inc, 3Com Corp and U.S. Robotics Corp, were active and powerful on Wednesday, declines in stocks like Microsoft Corp chipped away at gains, traders said.
Bay Networks was up 2-1/8 at 24-7/8, 3Com was up 2-7/16 at 49-3/16 and U.S. Robotics was up four at 84-3/4. Microsoft was off 7/8 at 125-3/4.
The long bond was up 5/32 at a 7.02 percent yield. ((Wall Street desk 212-859-1730))
